cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Welcome
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for a blanket-fort writing table where two invented market helpers start a scene with a warm hello: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the paper card beside a pencil and two small speaker tabs, then point to the moon muffin tray clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write two friendly lines that begin the made-up market scene inside the blanket fort: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the Moon Muffin stall keeper. Write a friendly first line about the glowing tray: "____________________."
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the blanket-fort visitor. Write a kind answer that uses an invented nickname: "____________________."
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that tells who spoke, such as said the stall keeper, then finish it: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the speaker feels welcoming with one tiny action: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write the next spoken line after the greeting: "____________________."
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Change one plain greeting into a Moon Muffin Market voice with a tray, lantern, or crumb clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point to one paper muffin first, then write just the first greeting words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: start a new market scene with one cozy hello: ____________________.

cards.title: Puddle Planet Post Office Question
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for a paper post-office scene where one invented speaker asks a clear question and the other answers it: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Set out a pretend envelope shape, a puddle stamp square, and the card, then choose one safe blanket-fort delivery clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write the question first, then write an answer that matches the question exactly: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the puddle-post clerk. Ask where the blue envelope should float: "____________________."
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the puddle traveler. Answer with a place, a reason, and a gentle voice: "____________________."
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag after the question that names the clerk: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the traveler is careful by adding an action before or after the answer: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write a reply that answers the exact question instead of changing the subject: "____________________."
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Make the reply sound more puddle-planet by adding a ripple, stamp, boot, or tiny orbit clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult leader reads the question once, and the writer fills only the answer words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: make a new pretend post-office question and one clear answer: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Library Train Tag
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for a fictional library-train scene where the writer adds tags that make each speaker clear: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the card with two paper ticket strips and ask the writer to choose a conductor and shelf passenger: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write two spoken lines, then add tags so a reader can tell who is speaking: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the ticket conductor. Give a quiet rail-car direction about the next shelf stop: "____________________."
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is a shelf passenger. Answer with a question about the buttonwood track: "____________________."
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that names the speaker and shows a calm library-train voice: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Add a quiet feeling clue, like smoothing a ticket or tapping a bookmark rail: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write the passenger's reply so it connects to the conductor's line: "____________________."
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise one plain line so it sounds like it belongs on a buttonwood rail car: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: underline the speaker name first, then write the tag after the spoken words: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: add one new train-platform line with a clear tag: ____________________.

cards.title: Button Bakery Map Fix
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for a pretend bakery map mixup where two speakers solve one small paper-scene problem: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Lay the card beside a folded paper map and one drawn button counter, then mark the mixed-up path clue: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a confused line, then answer it with one helpful fix that fits the bakery map: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the button baker. Ask for help because the path map points toward the wrong counter: "____________________."
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the map helper. Give one useful fix without taking over the whole story: "____________________."
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that shows which speaker offers the fix: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the baker feels puzzled with one small action near the paper map: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write a reply that offers one small fix the characters can try right away: "____________________."
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise the fix so it sounds polite and bakery-map specific: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: choose one of two adult-read fixes, then copy the better one into the blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: invent a new button-bakery mixup and one helpful reply: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Town Weather Window Hint
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for a blanket-fort weather-window scene where feelings are shown through action clues: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Put the card beside a paper teacup cart and choose one made-up weather-window symbol together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write two lines of dialogue, then add an action clue that shows how one speaker feels: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the weather-window watcher. Say what appears in the teacup window: "____________________."
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the teacup cart helper. Answer without naming the feeling first: "____________________."
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that names the watcher or helper: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show the feeling with a hand, cup, curtain, or cart action instead of only naming it: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write a reply that reacts to the weather clue and keeps the scene gentle: "____________________."
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Change "I feel unsure" into an action clue that fits Teacup Town: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the weather symbol first, then write one short feeling clue: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: make a new weather-window line that shows a feeling through action: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Notice Board Mixup
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable dialogue card for a fictional pocket-park notice board where two speakers disagree kindly and stay helpful: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Place the card with two paper notice slips and one drawn park bench, then pick the mixed-up notice together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write one suggestion and one polite disagreement that gives a clear reason: ____________________.
cards.speakerOnePrompt: Speaker one is the notice board helper. Suggest moving the picnic sign to a new spot: "____________________."
cards.speakerTwoPrompt: Speaker two is the bench gardener. Disagree kindly and give one reason from the paper park: "____________________."
cards.dialogueTagPrompt: Add a tag that shows who disagreed in a friendly way: ____________________.
cards.feelingCluePrompt: Show both speakers stay friendly with one small park action: ____________________.
cards.replyPrompt: Write the polite disagreement reply using kind words and one clear reason: "____________________."
cards.reviseLinePrompt: Revise a blunt no into a kind paper-park answer with a reason: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: circle the kind words first, then write the disagreement line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: make a new notice-board suggestion and one kind disagreement: ____________________.
